howItWorks.heading: From the map to your own parcel register in four steps

steps.title: Open the map
steps.description: Open the map, zoom to your cadastral area and tap a hexagon to read its soil quality, arable share and block size.

steps.title: Read the hex data
steps.description: Switch between the four layers to compare your area with its neighbours — quality, arable share, block size and farmland share.

steps.title: Log your parcels
steps.description: Sign in and add your land parcels with their current rental rates to build a personal register you can revisit and update any time.

steps.title: Reach out for help
steps.description: Contact us if you need support reading the data, understanding your rights, or preparing for a lease renegotiation.

items.question: Where does the land quality data come from?
items.answer: From the state's open data: BPEJ soil-ecological units (NPPC-VÚPOP, CC0) and the LPIS 2026 land-parcel blocks (PPA, CC BY 4.0), aggregated into hexagons. No cadastral transaction prices are used.

items.question: Is Agromapa a real estate trading platform?
items.answer: No. Agromapa is an information tool. It shows soil quality and land use so you can make better-informed decisions — it does not broker sales or rentals, and it shows no prices or rents.

items.question: Do I need to register to see the map?
items.answer: The public map is visible to everyone without signing in. Creating an account lets you log your own parcels, record rental rates and track them over time.

items.question: What does the block size tell me?
items.answer: It is the farmed area of a hexagon divided by the number of LPIS land blocks in it. Small blocks mean finely split land use. It describes how land is farmed, not how many people own it — ownership is not in open data.

items.question: Can I look up a specific cadastral parcel number?
items.answer: The current version shows aggregated data at hex level rather than individual parcel identifiers. You can log your own parcel details in the My Parcels section after signing in.

dashboard.title: My Parcels

listings.heading: Sample land zones on the map
listings.intro: These illustrative hexagonal zones show the kind of quality, rent and fragmentation data Agromapa carries for every cell across Slovakia.
listings.notice: These are illustrative example zones only — not real listings for sale or rent.

offer-1.title: Žitný ostrov arable zone
offer-1.summary: High-quality arable land in the Danubian lowland — hexagons with quality scores well above the national average and steady rental demand throughout the area.

offer-2.title: East Slovakia arable zone
offer-2.summary: Arable land in the Košice basin with moderate quality scores; a higher co-owner count makes consolidation conversations particularly worthwhile here.

offer-3.title: Orava highland grassland
offer-3.summary: Permanent grassland at higher elevation in the Orava region; below-average quality score but valued for livestock grazing and agri-environment payment eligibility.

offer-4.title: Záhorie vineyard zone
offer-4.summary: Premium vineyard land west of the Small Carpathians where BPEJ quality peaks and typical rent reflects the specialist nature of viticulture in the region.

offer-5.title: Nitra region arable zone
offer-5.summary: Productive arable land in the Nitra basin with above-average quality scores and an established, active rental market across the area.

contactForm.heading: Get in touch
contactForm.intro: Ask a question about the map, your land data or how to use Agromapa for your specific situation.

useCases.heading: Built for those without an analyst

items.title: The farmer before a lease renewal
items.situation: A small farmer has rented out a 4-hectare arable plot at the same rate for eight years and wants to know how good that land really is before the renewal talk.
items.action: They open the plot's hexagon, read its BPEJ quality and quality group against the neighbouring hexagons, and log the plot with its current rent in My parcels.

items.title: The co-owner deciding after an inheritance
items.situation: A person inherits a co-ownership share in several scattered plots and has no idea what they are worth or how they are currently managed.
items.action: They find each plot's hexagon, read its soil quality, dominant culture and block size, and keep the plots in one register before deciding what to do with them.

items.title: The beginning farmer scouting new land
items.situation: A young farmer planning to expand wants to know where the arable land in a neighbouring cadastral area is best and how it is farmed before approaching landowners.
items.action: They switch to the arable-share and quality layers, compare the hexagons of the target area, and approach owners knowing where the good fields are.

features.title: Hexagónová mapa kvality
features.description: Prezrite si skóre kvality odvodené z BPEJ pre každú hexagónovú bunku na Slovensku — od celonárodného po detailný miestny pohľad.

features.title: Podiel ornej pôdy
features.description: Uvidíte, aká časť poľnohospodárskej pôdy v hexagóne je orná a ktorá kultúra prevažuje: orná pôda, trávne porasty, vinica alebo sad.

features.description: Filtrujte mapu podľa ornej pôdy, trvalých trávnych porastov, viníc alebo sadov a zamerajte sa len na kultúru, ktorá vás zaujíma.

howItWorks.heading: Od mapy k vlastnému registru parciel v štyroch krokoch

steps.title: Otvorte mapu
steps.description: Otvorte mapu, priblížte svoje katastrálne územie a ťuknite na hexagón — uvidíte kvalitu pôdy, podiel ornej pôdy a veľkosť dielov.

steps.title: Prečítajte si dáta bunky
steps.description: Prepínajte štyri vrstvy a porovnajte svoje územie so susednými — kvalitu, podiel ornej pôdy, veľkosť dielov a podiel poľnohospodárskej pôdy.

steps.title: Evidujte svoje parcely
steps.description: Prihláste sa a pridajte vlastné parcely s aktuálnym nájomným, aby ste si budovali osobný register, ku ktorému sa kedykoľvek vrátite.

steps.title: Kontaktujte nás
steps.description: Napíšte nám, ak potrebujete pomoc s čítaním dát alebo s prípravou na rokovanie o nájme.

items.question: Odkiaľ pochádzajú dáta o kvalite pôdy?
items.answer: Z otvorených dát štátu: bonitované pôdno-ekologické jednotky BPEJ (NPPC-VÚPOP, CC0) a diely pôdnych blokov LPIS 2026 (PPA, CC BY 4.0), zoskupené do hexagónov. Katastrálne realizačné ceny sa nepoužívajú.

items.question: Je Agromapa realitná platforma?
items.answer: Nie. Agromapa je informačný nástroj. Zobrazuje kvalitu a využitie pôdy, aby ste sa rozhodovali informovanejšie — nesprostredkúva predaj ani prenájom a neukazuje ceny ani nájomné.

items.question: Musím sa registrovať, aby som videl mapu?
items.answer: Verejná mapa je prístupná každému bez prihlásenia. Po vytvorení účtu môžete evidovať vlastné parcely, zaznamenávať nájomné a sledovať jeho vývoj v čase.

items.question: Čo mi povie veľkosť dielov?
items.answer: Je to obhospodarovaná plocha hexagónu vydelená počtom dielov pôdnych blokov LPIS v ňom. Malé diely znamenajú rozdrobené využívanie pôdy. Hovorí o tom, ako sa pôda obhospodaruje, nie koľko má vlastníkov — vlastníctvo v otvorených dátach nie je.

items.question: Môžem vyhľadať konkrétne číslo katastrálnej parcely?
items.answer: Aktuálna verzia zobrazuje agregované dáta na úrovni hexagónu, nie jednotlivé čísla parciel. Vlastné parcely môžete evidovať v sekcii Moje parcely po prihlásení.
